mechanism: Both drugs have Class IA antiarrhythmic properties and can prolong QT interval; chloroquine inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of mexiletine, increasing its serum concentrations and cardiac toxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor ECG closely, reduce mexiletine dose, and monitor for signs of mexiletine toxicity including arrhythmias, tremor, and cardiac conduction abnormalities.
